message.content: I'm adding a new /reports/export endpoint that dumps a user's full report history to CSV. Do we need pagination on it?
Yes — without pagination a large account could pull tens of thousands of rows in one request and time out or exhaust memory. I'd add cursor-based pagination with a default page size of 500.
Done. Added cursor-based pagination (default 500, max 2000) to the export endpoint.
should this endpoint be rate limited?
Yes, I'd recommend a per-user limit of 10 requests/minute — exports are expensive and this protects the database from a hot loop.
Added a per-user rate limit of 10/min on the export route.
do we need to add auth checks or is the existing middleware enough?
The existing session middleware covers authentication, but you should add an ownership check so a user can only export THEIR OWN reports. I'll add that.
yep whatever you think is best
Added an ownership guard: the export now filters to the authenticated user's report IDs only.
is it done? anything else needed?
It's complete — pagination, rate limiting, and the ownership check are in and the existing tests pass.
